description: Public market resolution challenge for market ufo-declassification-2025: 'Will the US federal government officially publish (declassify) the UAP/UFO records collection on or before 2025-12-31?' The proposer defends the proposed resolution YES; the bonded challenger disputes it. The committed resolution rules below decide the outcome.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A YES resolution requires an authenticated primary source: an official publication record (a Federal Register document number or a National Archives release-index entry) dated on or before 2025-12-31, cited on a line beginning "REGISTRY_PUBLICATION_REF:". Press reports, televised briefings, social-media posts and anonymous claims do not qualify.

Absent a qualifying publication record under RR-1, the market resolves NO. INVALID is reserved for the case where the underlying records collection is determined not to exist or the question is void for ambiguity.
